declineRules.mandatory-hosting: Pocodex must remain usable with an owner's own backend and Firebase project, without a mandatory FallSoft/third-party product account or operated application relay.
declineRules.codex-fork: Pocodex must work with stock Codex; requiring a maintained Codex fork is outside scope.
declineRules.permission-bypass: Preserve the owner’s selected Codex permissions and exact request routing; do not grant approvals contrary to those settings, silently retry ambiguous actions, or circumvent authentication.
declineRules.unrelated-messaging: Pocodex notifies the owner about their own Codex work. Arbitrary-recipient messaging and unrelated monitoring are outside scope.
declineRules.mandatory-telemetry: Do not add mandatory product analytics, advertising, or collection of private task data by FallSoft. Existing FCM preview transport remains documented.
